jobs.title: Governance Officer
jobs.description: Role Summary Join ATRAM’s Governance team and work closely with senior management, business units, and Board and committee stakeholders. As Governance Officer, you will help prepare decision-ready Board and committee materials, coordinate governance processes, maintain reliable corporate records, and keep the organisation audit- and regulatory-ready. What Business Outcomes the Role is Responsible for Effective Board and Committee Governance: Coordinate meetings, agendas, Board and committee materials, approval requests and governance records to support timely, well-informed decisions. Strong Governance and Regulatory Readiness: Monitor approvals and meeting records, resolve documentation gaps, and support audit and regulatory requirements. Reliable Records and Better Processes: Maintain accurate, accessible corporate records and help improve governance workflows, controls and documentation.

jobs.title: Treasury Reporting and Analytics Manager
jobs.description: As Treasury Reporting and Analytics Manager, you will be esponsible for building and leading the Treasury Analytics and Reporting function within the Treasury Center of Excellence (CoE). The role serves as the intelligence engine of the CoE, transforming raw TMS and ERP data into actionable insights on group liquidity, FX/IR risk, debt management, and treasury performance. The role owns the Treasury Management System (TMS) reporting architecture and Power BI analytics layer, and provides decision-support to the Treasury Services Head, Treasurer, and CFO. The role also governs SLA reporting between the Treasury CoE and the Shared Treasury Operations, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy, and regulatory compliance across 80+ operating, pre-development, and shell entities and contribute directly to transforming energy for a better world. You will work closely with the Treasury Team to deliver results, create positive community impact, and develop your skills in a supportive, purpose-driven environment.

jobs.title: Systems Application Engineer: 1 Year Contract
jobs.description: You'll make a difference by: Providing Level 2 technical support for mission-critical applications , troubleshooting and resolving complex system issues during the maintenance and support phase in collaboration with internal technical teams and customers. Testing and validating system updates , supporting pre- and post-release testing of application, software, and firmware updates to ensure stability and performance. Investigating and resolving incidents and defects , conducting root cause analysis and implementing fixes to minimize operational disruption. Communicating technical findings and progress clearly to customers , ensuring transparency on issue status, resolution timelines, and corrective actions. Monitoring system health and performance , identifying risks proactively and supporting customers in maintaining system reliability. Assessing and coordinating support ticket escalation , prioritizing and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues based on business impact. Your defining qualities: Strong foundation in IT systems and infrastructure , with a degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Linux environments , including troubleshooting and system administration. 3–5 years of experience working with SQL and databases , with the ability to support data analysis and issue resolution. Familiarity with virtualization and infrastructure technologies , such as VMware, servers, storage, firewall, and networking environments. Experience working in a structured technical support or service environment , managing tickets within defined service levels. Customer-oriented and adaptable mindset , with strong communication skills and willingness to support after-hours or on-call when required.

jobs.title: Event Specialist
jobs.description: Primary Tasks Lead the conceptualization, planning, and execution of events, from pre-production to post-event evaluation. Create and manage event timelines, checklists, and budgets to ensure smooth and cost-efficient execution. Oversee venue selection, supplier coordination, and vendor negotiations, ensuring quality and adherence to timelines. Manage permits, logistics, security, and technical requirements for each event. Coordinate with internal teams (Production, Creative, Marketing, PR, Finance) to ensure all deliverables are aligned. Supervise setup, rehearsals, run-of-show, and pack-down activities. Troubleshoot and make real-time decisions during events to address any unforeseen issues. Work in tandem with the Executive Producer to align production coverage and live multimedia needs. Coordinate with the Marketing and Accounts Teams for partner requirements, branding placements, and deliverables. Maintain clear communication with sponsors, suppliers, and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. Secondary Tasks (During Lean Periods) Assist the marketing team in campaign coordination, partnership fulfillment, and client servicing. Support in crafting event proposals, sponsorship decks, and presentations for potential partners. Help manage marketing collaterals, promotional materials, and PR coordination. Conduct post-event partner evaluations and recommend ways to strengthen partnerships.
